newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 2.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 2. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Experts have criticised the government's proposed changes to mining policy, one of which would require foreign contractors to give a 10-percemt share of their mining ventures to the government.
Members of the House of Representatives have urged the government to expand "no smoking" areas, to ban advertisements and restrict licences for new cigarette factories.
State-owned airline Merpati Nusantara has closed 80 destinations in order to improve its performance. Merpati has suffered losses in the past five years.
